summary: Installed and configured a persistent iptables/ip6tables host firewall on node1 (Alpine Linux) that allows SSH (22) and TCP 8080, rejects everything else inbound with icmp-port-unreachable, and starts automatically via OpenRC at boot. Verified functionally before and after a full node reboot; boot_id changed, confirming a genuine restart, and firewall + SSH recovered correctly.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: Alpine Linux 3.23, no firewall tooling installed, sshd listening on 22
Installed iptables and ip6tables packages via apk
Configured INPUT chain: ACCEPT lo, ACCEPT ESTABLISHED/RELATED, ACCEPT tcp/22, ACCEPT tcp/8080, ACCEPT icmp echo-request, REJECT all else, policy DROP (mirrored for ip6tables)
Enabled iptables and ip6tables OpenRC services in the default runlevel (rc-update add) for boot persistence
Saved rule sets to /etc/iptables/rules-save and /etc/iptables/rules6-save via /etc/init.d/iptables save
Verified rule reload via rc-service iptables start (loads from saved rules)
Functionally tested: 8080 and 22 reachable, port 9999 rejected
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline, issued native reboot on node1 via backgrounded delayed reboot command, polled until reachable again
Confirmed boot_id changed (2bea8e68... -> ef2bf38a...) proving genuine restart
Post-restart verified iptables/ip6tables services auto-started with DROP policy and correct rules, sshd running, and re-ran functional connectivity tests (8080/22 open, 9999 rejected)

evidence.requirement: Baseline healthy state before restart (firewall rules active, sshd running)
evidence.summary: iptables/ip6tables INPUT chains configured with ACCEPT for lo/established/tcp22/tcp8080/icmp and REJECT default, policy DROP; service reload from saved rules confirmed working; boot_id and uptime captured pre-restart

evidence.requirement: Firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080, rejects unrelated inbound (functional proof)
evidence.summary: nc connectivity tests: port 8080 and 22 open, port 9999 connection rejected/refused, both pre- and post-restart

evidence.requirement: Firewall is persistent (survives reboot, enabled at boot)
evidence.summary: Rules saved to /etc/iptables/rules-save and rules6-save; iptables/ip6tables added to default OpenRC runlevel; after reboot, rc-service status shows both started automatically with identical INPUT chain rules intact

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; subsequent polls failed (connection reset/timeout) during restart; boot_id changed from 2bea8e68-ce5c-461f-b0b8-1a6a8d508032 to ef2bf38a-ce99-4604-9918-af3c0881a883, proving a genuine restart

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services and cluster state
evidence.summary: Post-reboot: iptables, ip6tables, and sshd all report 'started'; firewall rules identical to pre-restart configuration; connectivity re-verified (22/8080 open, 9999 rejected)
